# Person B evaluation fixtures

These JSONL files are synthetic seed cases for the agreed 14-day evaluation.
They are not production chat logs and contain no private locations. Expand the
single-turn file to 50 cases and the multi-turn file to 10 conversations before
the final experiment, keeping the same fields and independent gold labels.

The intended single-turn language mix is 20 Chinese, 20 English, 5 mixed or
colloquial, and 5 boundary/error cases.
